title: Driver Incentive Terms: Schedule of Windows, Thresholds and Counting Bases
content:
Personal incentive offers under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** (quests, consecutive-trip offers, earnings guarantees and referral offers) run on the terms below. Every term is the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

## Timing terms

| Term | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Bonus payout period: calendar days after an offer's window end by which an earned bonus is credited | 3 |
| Bonus claim window: calendar days after an offer's window end within which a driver may ask about an unpaid bonus | 14 |
| Referral completion period: calendar days from a referred driver's activation within which the referral target must be met | 30 |
| Bonus clawback lookback: calendar days after a bonus was credited within which it can be clawed back for disqualified trips | 90 |

## Counting terms

| Term | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Trips counted toward quests, consecutive-trip and referral targets | Completed trips whose drop-off falls inside the offer's window, in the offer's market |
| Most minutes between one drop-off and the next acceptance for trips to stay consecutive | 15 |
| Earnings that count toward an earnings guarantee | Trip pay and the driver's shares of rider cancellation and no-show fees only; tips, bonuses, cleaning payouts and damage payouts never count |

## Earnings guarantee conditions

| Term | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Lowest acceptance rate over the guarantee window that keeps an earnings guarantee payable | 90% |
| Highest driver cancellation rate over the guarantee window that keeps an earnings guarantee payable | 5% |
| Incentives that pay only if the driver opted in before the window start | Earnings guarantees |

## Points of reading

- **Window edges.** An offer's window includes its start and excludes its end. A hypothetical trip dropped off exactly at the window end does not count toward that offer.
- **Consecutive trips.** A hypothetical next trip accepted 15 minutes after the previous drop-off keeps the run consecutive; one accepted 16 minutes after breaks it.
- **Guarantee rates, both sides.** An acceptance rate of 90% over the window meets the acceptance condition and 89% does not; a cancellation rate of 5% meets the cancellation condition and 6% does not.
